text.title: Blood at the Ford
text.body: The gnoll horde under Chieftain Grok'tar has overwhelmed the river border and set fire to the granaries. You march alone as the realm's Lone Wolf champion across this massive wilderness. Cross the Sunken Ford, scour the expanses, uncover hidden supply caches, and storm Grok'tar's stronghold before the valley falls to ruin.
text.msg.1: Warden Hale grips your shoulder: "You ride alone, champion. The horde breached the Sunken Ford at twilight. Tread carefully—the willows are thick with wolf packs, and Grok'tar's scouts hold the ridges. Put an end to their chieftain!"
text.msg.2: Hissing battle cries erupt from the reeds! Gnoll ambushers emerge with drawn bows and barbed spears!
text.msg.3: The ford is secure! The river runs crimson. Grok'tar's fortified war-camp lies beyond the High Bluff Ridge to the north-east.
text.msg.4: Chieftain Grok'tar collapses in a heap of broken iron and shattered bone! With their warlord slain, the gnoll horde scatters in terror. Thornwick is saved!
text.msg.6: Chieftain Grok'tar roars: "Weak little two-legs! You come alone into my domain?! Your flesh will roast over our war-pyres!"
text.msg.7: Beneath the charred granary floorboards, you uncover an ironbound chest filled with stolen provisions and 300 gold sovereigns!
text.msg.8: With the Shaman Cabal vanquished, holy light surges from the ancient shrine, dispelling the corrupted blood curse across the bluff!
text.win: Chieftain Grok'tar is dead and his warband is completely broken. Thornwick and the surrounding valleys can rebuild in peace.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen in the wilderness. Without your blade, Thornwick falls to the gnoll raiders.
